Your information

Privacy.

How enquiries and optional website analytics are handled.

What you send

The contact form asks for your name, email address, an optional business name and a message. Please don’t include passwords, payment details or sensitive customer information.

How it is used

Ben Young uses these details to respond to your enquiry and discuss the services you have asked about. Submitting an enquiry does not sign you up to a marketing list.

Services used to deliver your message

The form is processed by Formspree and enquiries are delivered to Ben Young’s Gmail inbox. These services may process information outside Australia. Their own privacy policies describe how they handle data: Formspree privacy policy and Google privacy policy.

Website data

The hosting and form providers may process technical information, such as IP addresses and request logs, to operate and protect their services.

Google Analytics

This website uses Google Analytics 4 to understand which pages visitors use, where visits come from and whether an enquiry is successfully submitted. Google uses cookies and device identifiers, and processes technical information such as browser, device and approximate location. Analytics loads when you visit unless you have opted out in this browser.

Names, email addresses, business names and messages entered in the enquiry form are not sent to Analytics. An enquiry event records only that the form was successfully submitted. Page URLs sent by this website omit query strings and fragments. Google Signals and advertising personalisation are disabled.

Google may process information outside Australia. Read how Google uses information from sites that use its services and the Google privacy policy.

Your choice

You can use the website and send an enquiry with analytics turned off. Select “Turn off analytics” in the footer to stop future analytics events and remove this website’s Google Analytics cookies. The control changes to “Turn on analytics” if you wish to enable it again. Your choice is saved in your browser’s local storage; clearing site data resets it. Opting out does not remove information already processed by Google.

Access, correction or deletion

To ask about information you have provided, request a correction or request deletion, email benjaminyoung8@gmail.com.
